**Temporary Closure of the Library’s East Entrance (Monday–Thursday)**

From Monday through Thursday, the neighborhood library’s east entrance—the entrance facing the bus shelter—will be closed to everyone, including wheelchair users, while the pavement immediately outside it is replaced. The entrance must close because a temporary barrier will block the direct path between the bus shelter and the east doors, though people using the bus shelter will still be able to wait there. The library itself will remain open on its usual schedule via the west entrance facing the playground.

Visitors coming from the playground can use the west entrance as normal. Visitors coming from the bus shelter should instead follow the signed path along the south side of the building to reach the west entrance. This route to the west entrance adds approximately 120 metres to the journey; it has no steps, and a temporary firm mat covers one section of uneven ground.

During library opening hours, staff can meet visitors at the bus shelter and accompany them to the west entrance, although we cannot provide transport around the building. Call the library desk before setting out if you would like this assistance. You may also request it on arrival by calling the number displayed at the bus shelter, but a staff member may not be available immediately.

Because the returns slot beside the east entrance will also be inaccessible during the closure, books due from Monday through Thursday—including those borrowed from another branch—may be returned on Friday without a late charge. If heavy rain delays the work, an updated notice will be posted at both entrances and at the bus shelter. The Friday return arrangement will remain in place unless that updated notice announces a further extension.
